PluginData.Tooltip: Aim at a block and press Ctrl+G to pick it.
PluginData.Description:
Block Picker
Hold any block, aim at a block (built or projected) and press the keybind (default: Ctrl+G) to pick it. The block is selected on your build bar (added to a free slot if needed), and its paint color can be picked too. Respects survival progression. Everything is configurable in the plugin settings.
